text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In order to gauge the movements of her 
generation rivals, you came to spectate 
the Satsuki Sho with Cheval Grand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The brilliant prodigies of Cheval Grand's 
generation—including Kitasan Black and 
Satono Crown—clashed fiercely on the grand 
stage!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Duramente was particularly awe-inspiring 
among the field. With a ferocious burst of 
late speed that overwhelmed all who 
watched, she blew past the pack in an 
instant to seize victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her rival's strength was beyond 
expectations, but discovering that now is 
a stroke of luck. She resolves to hone her 
skills toward the day of their showdown.
